name: shimmer-sweep
title: Shimmer Sweep
description: A bright shine travels once across muted text, left to right: a refined metallic gleam that draws attention to text already on screen. It does not animate the text in.
useWhen: Highlighting a product name or pricing tier with a metallic gleam on a premium slide.
The text is already visible and you want an attention effect rather than an entrance.
avoidWhen: The text needs to enter the scene: use tracking-in or soft-blur-in first, then layer a shimmer.
The tone is casual or energetic: use spring-scale-in or staggered-fade-up.
You want per-character colour control: the sweep is one beam.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Base color
variables.description: Dim color of the text underneath the shine.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed multiplier. The shine crosses in the first 80 % of the block at speed 1.
